column5: The Rust leaf ports DeltaUpdate construction and UpdateStatsMeta SQL assembly from lines 48-152: locked/unlocked partitioning, positive/negative delta buckets, ordered IDs and tuples, exact SELECT-for-update/INSERT statements, cache invalidation IDs, and Go int64 wrapping for MinInt64 negation. It also preserves UpdateStatsMetaVerAndLastHistUpdateVer's exact query and ordered arguments from lines 178-197. Session/transaction execution, start-timestamp acquisition, variable.TableDelta conversion, global-stats renames, and storage lifecycle remain external.
